name: Gaussian Fiber Distribution
definition: A microflake normal distribution used by Zhao et al. [ZJMB11]. It is more efficient than the original implementation of Jakob et al. [JAM* 10], but does not provide a closed-form expression for the attenuation coefficient (using an efficient approximation [Jak10]).
summary: The Gaussian Fiber Distribution is an efficient microflake normal distribution function for simulating anisotropic media, distinguished by its computational speed over sine/cosine alternatives despite lacking a closed-form attenuation coefficient.
